design: Chibi idol songstress, 2.1-head, Qwen-brand little sister, HD-2D pixel sprite. Long periwinkle-to-cyan gradient twin-tails (#7B8CF0 to #5CE1E6) whose ends flow like sound-wave ribbons. White headset with a small boom mic and a hexagon emblem on the ear cup. Outfit: white-and-indigo idol dress whose chest panel shows glowing equalizer bars, a layered tulle skirt, and indigo boots with tiny speaker grilles. A paper price-tag charm reading '1/4' dangles from her belt. Small colored speech bubbles float around her, each with a different voice icon (bright girl, deep man, child, elder), showing her many voices. personality: 一人分饰百角的歌姬妹妹，开口就是满分声线，价格还很亲民

design: Chibi creature mascot: a small lilac-violet fawn with a big head and tiny legs, HD-2D pixel sprite. Soft coat #9B8CF5 with white spots shaped like little film frames. Huge kaleidoscope eyes with shifting rainbow facets. From its nubby budding antlers hang tiny node boxes joined by colorful noodle wires (a ComfyUI nod), plus an open-padlock charm for open source. A short film-strip ribbon is tied around its neck like a scarf, flickering a 5-second loop. Pose: playful hop with front hooves lifted, trailing sparkles of pixels. Palette: lilac #9B8CF5, white, violet #5B4CF0, rainbow accents.
lookZh: 万花筒眼睛的小鹿，鹿角上挂着 ComfyUI 节点
personality: 在开源草地上蹦跶的小鹿，谁都能给它的鹿角接上新节点

design: Chibi creature, evolved Wan: an elegant nine-colored deer inspired by the Dunhuang mural deer. Larger HD-2D pixel sprite, but still chibi-cute. The same lilac base coat (#9B8CF5) now carries nine iridescent color bands in the Dunhuang mineral palette: azure, malachite green, cinnabar, ochre, gold, violet. Full branching antlers are wrapped by a long unrolling handscroll that plays a continuous 30-second panorama; small music notes and a speech bubble float off the scroll (native audio). Its kaleidoscope eyes are now calm and golden. Auspicious clouds drift under its hooves, and a golden hexagon-star pendant hangs from a ribbon collar. Behind it, tiny slide, spreadsheet and web-page icons morph into film frames (document-to-video). Pose: graceful prance in mid-air. Palette: lilac, mineral blue #2E6FB0, malachite #2F9E7A, cinnabar #C8442F, gold #E3B74B.
lookZh: 九色神鹿般的成年万相，身上流动着 30 秒长卷画
personality: 从敦煌壁画里走出来的九色神鹿，一镜到底，还能开口唱

design: Chibi creature mascot: a round, cheerful pastel pony with 2-head body proportions, HD-2D pixel sprite. Its mane and tail are bands of rainbow light. It wears a small black Venetian masquerade mask with a white question-mark charm (its anonymous debut) and a tiny film-clapperboard saddle. Every hoof step leaves 8 glowing square light dots like stair steps (8-step distillation). A speaker-shaped bell on its collar stands for video with audio, next to a mini '1080p' tag. Pose: galloping leap, big happy open-mouth smile, one eye winking behind the mask. Palette: cream body #FFF6EC, rainbow mane (#FF6B6B, #FFC145, #6BCB77, #4D96FF, #9D4EDD), black mask, gold accents.

personality: 蒙面空降的神秘彩虹小马，跑得快心态好，被超车了也照样快乐

design: Chibi creature mascot, HD-2D pixel sprite: a round, half-open oyster shell with two stubby arms and tiny feet peeking out. The outer shell is pearly gray-white with soft ridges and a cute face on its lower lip, with sparkly eyes. Inside sits a glowing pearl that is a tiny walkable planet: little hills, a castle, a winding path, and a small explorer flag stuck in it. Mood mechanic: the pearl-world's color and the creature's float height change with emotion. Happy = floats with a sky-blue glow; sad = sinks, tinted indigo; angry = lava-orange cracks; anxious = the world swirls. Pose: hovering slightly, arms raised, offering its pearl world. Palette: pearl white #F2F1EC, shell gray #9AA0A6, black outline, pearl gradient #A7E3FF to #FFD6F5.
lookZh: 半开的生蚝壳里托着一颗珍珠小星球，壳边伸出两只小短手，开心时会飘起来（致敬 B站「蚝的七种心情」）
personality: 情绪都写在地形上的小生蚝，开心会飘、难过会沉，壳里藏着一整个世界

design: Chibi creature mascot, HD-2D pixel sprite: a small curled shrimp in a coral-to-peach gradient (#FE6849 to #FFB199). Its body segments are shaped like round music-note heads, and its tail fan curls like a little treble-clef flourish. It wears oversized black over-ear headphones. Its two long antennae are coiled microphone cables ending in tiny mics. On its back sits a retro orange vinyl-record shell plate with groove rings, a nod to the old Xiami player. It holds a tiny pencil and a lyric sheet. Colorful note bubbles and concentric orange-and-blue sound rings float around it. Pose: bopping to the beat with eyes closed and a happy smile. Palette: coral #FE6849, peach #FFB199, near-black #191B1F, cream, accent blue #4D96FF.
lookZh: 戴大耳机的粉色小虾米，两根长须是麦克风线，背壳是复古橙色的唱片纹
personality: 一句大白话就能写整首歌的小虾米，老网友心里的白月光回来了

design: Chibi fox-eared coder boy, 2.1-head, HD-2D pixel sprite. Messy black hair with one ahoge shaped like a text cursor '|', and fluffy fox ears tipped fresh green (#3DBE5B). He wears a black oversized hoodie with a white outlined Q-glyph on the chest and green drawstrings, plus shorts and green-soled sneakers; big white headphones rest around his neck. His large fluffy fox tail is built from stacked, semi-transparent gray 'ghost-text' code blocks; the blocks flash green when accepted (autocomplete). He holds a bright green apple with one bite out of it (a nod to Newton's 1666 tree) and has a floating mini laptop. A tiny UFO drone hovers above his head. Pose: typing on an air keyboard with a confident smirk. Palette: black #090A0B, white, green #3DBE5B, violet accent #8B5CF6.
lookZh: 戴耳机的程序员小灵狐，尾巴是一串补全提示
personality: 把活替你干完的程序员小狐狸，尾巴一甩就是一串代码补全

design: Chibi bookish literature girl, 2-head, HD-2D pixel sprite. Silver-white long straight hair with soft lavender shadows, a golden crescent-moon hairpin, and a small blue bead clip (the logo dot). Sleepy, gentle violet eyes. Outfit: oversized navy (#1F2A5A) cardigan with sleeves past her hands over a white blouse; a tiny triangular prism brooch casts a thin rainbow line across her chest. Navy pleated skirt with a moon-dust speckled hem, white knee socks. She hugs an impossibly tall stack of books while a very long paper scroll trails behind her across the ground (long context). Pose: peeking over the book stack with a slight head tilt. Cozy and simple (stage 1). Palette: silver #E8EAF2, navy #1F2A5A, black #0B0B0F, Kimi blue dot #1E7BFF, prism-rainbow accents.
lookZh: 月牙发卡的文学少女（B站同人「Kimi娘」），抱着比自己还高的书堆
personality: 安静的长文本文学少女，二百万字一口气读完，还能帮你划重点

design: Chibi evolved Kimi, 2.3-head, HD-2D pixel sprite. The same silver-white hair, now longer, with a side braid and a larger crescent-moon headpiece. A small triangular prism hangs from it and splits light into a rainbow band. Outfit: a starry navy-black cape lined with moon-dust speckles and constellation dots; white blouse with a black ribbon and a 'K' charm; navy corset skirt with silver buttons; black boots. Tool icons orbit her like juggling balls (wrench, magnifier, terminal, browser, calculator), linked by thin light lines for her chains of hundreds of tool calls. The cape clasp is a small snowy mountain peak emblem marked 'K2', and an open-padlock charm stands for open weights. Companion: a tiny floating moon-shadow spirit with one blue-dot eye. Pose: tossing tools from one hand like a juggler, confident wink. Palette: silver #E8EAF2, navy #1F2A5A, black #0B0B0F, Kimi blue #1E7BFF, prism-rainbow accents.
lookZh: 月之暗面少女期，披星空斗篷，手里抛接一串工具图标
personality: 从图书馆走向星空的月之少女，连调几百次工具也不慌

Floor-length silver-white hair fading to ice-blue tips, small ahoge, one thin side braid threaded with star beads; sapphire-blue eyes with crescent highlights. personality: 开源老前辈的幼崽形态，爱打瞌睡，一张显卡就能养活。
